name: An owner’s roadmap: its steps and links, absent ones kept, its meta and kinds, and each mark dated by the server once no queued entry still changes it, else by the device
A roadmap someone else owns is present and not theirs, placed by its meta, with no mark or pointer
A fork says the roadmap it was copied from: its meta's forkedFrom, which the server writes
A roadmap whose record in the person’s list is dead is not present, and its record places it
A tree scope the server has not answered for and the device holds nothing of is unread
A tree scope the server answered for with nothing is read, and empty
A tree scope the server is still sending is unread, whatever the device holds of it so far: its first pull has not ended, and the rows it brought are the server’s
A roadmap the device made, of which the server has sent nothing, is read before the server answers: the device holds the whole of it
One tree’s openings: a subtree takes precedence, pointers open roots, and an unknown target is not dangling
One tree’s openings: a pointer loop leads back, and a tree with no steps is not complete
One tree’s openings: a known deleted pointer target dangles
One tree’s openings: an unread owned subtree keeps precedence over a completed root pointer

The person’s list: their own roots that stand, newest first by the server’s last receipt, ties by id, never received last; no subtree, deleted or someone else’s roadmap, nor a root whose meta has not arrived
A roadmap as a list shows it, whoever owns it: someone else's root that stands, by its title, counts and last receipt
A roadmap as a list shows it: none for one that does not stand, such as a root read with no meta

One tree’s openings with what a read elsewhere tells of the subtrees the device holds no copy of: each counts as it is told, complete once it has steps and every one is done, one with no steps not complete; a subtree the device has read counts from its copy whatever it is told, and one it is told nothing of stays unknown

A roadmap's progress with what a read elsewhere tells of its subtrees: a step whose subtree is told complete is complete, dated by its own complete mark as that read dated it, stamped or not, else by its subtree's stamp; one told unfinished, or told nothing, sets its mark aside
A roadmap told of but not read has no progress: a subtree the device holds unread, whatever it is told, reads none
A roadmap read under one the device holds unread has no progress, as it does not stand, whatever it is told
